// The closest point on a 3D surface to a query point. IFace is the triangle
// holding the closest point (-1 when the target is not a mesh); Barycentric
// locates it within that triangle.
type ClosestPointResult3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Distance: Number;
    Face: FaceIndex;
    Barycentric: BarycentricCoordinate;
}
